title: The Sun in seven SDO channels, 2024-05-10 12:00 UTC

registration.method: shared grid, checked by limb fit and 15 sunspots
registration.notes: HMI 6173 against AIA 1700: limb radius 1583.3 px against 1583.6 expected, 15 sunspots give scale 1.00081, rotation 0.0157 degrees, RMS 2.05 px; no flip or roll. The other five AIA channels share the level 1.5 header grid and were not measured on the pixels.

validation.notes: Draft for science review (G-02). Facts and their status: docs/science/sun-sdo.md.
